entries.notes: The round button opens the display panel; A11yPanel renders both (button + sheet).
large = Magazin hub variant (image 16:10); the library tile is the regular size.
Figma "Icon" (instance swap) has no code counterpart: the code button always renders ArrowUpRight. "State" Hover/Focus are interaction states (CSS), only Disabled maps to a prop.

Only for the APL rule freeCancellation = UNTIL_24H_BEFORE_EVENT; cutoff = event start − 24 h.

Decorative round arrow in the corner of a linked card; the card itself is the link (group hover turns it 45°). tone: glass (default, dark cards) · photo (on photos) · solid (featured article); size: md 44 px · sm 36 px.
Pins are computed from the club entries (open + planned); labels from homeContent[locale].leader.
The library tile is the compact grid tile; variant="feature" is the large carousel tile.
courtType is the APL court type prefix of the app icon ("double" → double_court, "single" → single_court).
App deeplink + web app link for one event; showLabel renders the small "Anmelden" label above the buttons.
Children are FactRows (format, deadline, max. participants, free places – only those the APL delivers).
One key fact of an event; render inside a <dl> (EventSignupCard or the left column of the event detail).
Filter chips are plain buttons styled with sheetChip(active) (club finder filter sheet).
Desktop/Mobile is responsive in code (lg breakpoint); the mobile menu overlay is part of Header.
Claim, lead, CTAs and search texts come from homeContent[locale].hero (Contentful module heroHome). Video on tablet/desktop, poster only on phones; the pause button is part of the component.
One Figma tile = one item of KpiTiles (grid of 2/4 tiles in code).
Leaflet divIcon from ClubMap.tsx (module-internal helper pin(active, planned); styles in locations/map.css).
Rendered by <Header /> below lg; the header owns the toggle, Esc, focus return and the inert page.
Rendered by <Header /> for every main navigation entry; active = the current page (aria-current="page"). "Hover" is the CSS hover state, no prop.

Default/Success are runtime states of the form (success after submit). One newsletter for the whole site (footer): title and text come from the dictionary, not from props. `id="newsletter"` is the anchor "Benachrichtige mich" on planned clubs jumps to.
The status variants are computed on the client from club.openingHours (openStatusText in src/components/locations/geo.ts).
Headline as children with one <Accent> word; image from Contentful (without image: Brandbook gradient).
Contentful module partnerLogos; partners defaults to all partner entries.
Name/role come from the person entry; without a confirmed photo the branded initials placeholder renders.
Default/Filled/Focus are runtime states (Filled shows the clear button).
Wrap the one accent word of the title in <Accent>…</Accent> (Good Brush, Optic Yellow).
"Open" is a runtime state (listbox open), not a prop. In the Default state the shown text is the placeholder.
"Copied" is the 2-second confirmation after copying the link (desktop without share sheet) – internal state, no prop. track: analytics event name (share_club, share_event, share_article).
The code component always renders both badges (App Store + Google Play).
Real player voices only with consent – the prototype shows placeholders.
Optic Yellow band: Marquee with claim items and dots (see HomeView / Footer); includes the pause button (WCAG 2.2.2).
